steps.name: Given the application is running with real Redis
BE not reachable at http://localhost:8080 — start the stack (npm run stack:up)
Given a fresh company user is authenticated for rate-limit testing
When I make a GET request to "/test/health"
Then the response status should be 200
And the rate-limit headers should advertise a consistent STANDARD contract
Limit must be a positive number, got "60"
Remaining must be Limit - 1 after the first request
